soap.versionLabel: Accessible label of the SOAP 1.1 and 1.2 switch.
soap.format: Button that indents the XML envelope. Keep XML.
soap.fault: Heading shown when the response is a SOAP fault, an error returned by a SOAP service.
soap.faultReason: Label of the human-readable cause in a SOAP fault.
soap.faultActor: Label of the party that raised the fault (the SOAP actor or role).
soap.faultDetail: Label of the extra data of a SOAP fault.
